_why: THE SLAG HULK's body (builder B, NIGHT26 contract hulk; GG: 'an easier boss first'). A slow walking bruiser built from oriented boxes in its own frame (a = right, b = up from the feet, c = forward, metres; half = half sizes), each box one named part: `back` and `head` are the weak points (x2 in design.n26.bosses.hulk.hp), everything else is `body` (x1). The back plate sticks out 0.15 m behind the torso so a shot from behind finds it first. The numbers of the fight are in design.n26.bosses.hulk. Unity-only: the web had no hulk. The view draws exactly these boxes (blocky models as they are, GG owns enemy design).
